name: artifact-use
description: Publish agent output as stable, gated, reviewable links through Artifact Use without Cloudflare credentials.

interface.shortDescription: Publish artifacts as gated, reviewable links.
interface.longDescription: Artifact Use lets Codex publish single-file or folder artifacts (HTML tools, dashboards, static folders, images, PDFs) to a hosted Cloudflare-backed service over MCP with OAuth sign-in. Every artifact gets a stable /go/ URL, immutable versions, a viewer gate, share links, stats, and reviewer comments the agent can read and resolve. It publishes only when asked and republishes the same link on request.
interface.defaultPrompt: Publish this artifact with Artifact Use and give me the review link.
